title.tr: Tahta panel arkalıklı TV ünitesi, hoparlör gözleri
title.en: TV unit with a board-panel back, with speaker bays

alt.tr: Yatay tahta panel arkalıklı ahşap TV ünitesi; iki yanda hoparlör gözleri, ortada cihaz rafı
alt.en: A timber TV unit with a horizontal board-panel back, with speaker bays at both sides and a shelf for equipment in the middle

caption.tr: Televizyon panelin üzerine asılı, altında iki yanda hoparlör gözleri, ortada cihaz rafı var. Panel koyu vernikli yatay tahtalardan.
caption.en: The television hangs on the panel, with speaker bays at both sides below it and an equipment shelf in the middle. The panel is made of dark varnished horizontal boards.
